instagram.author: niyi.tech
instagram.body:
A free, local-first alternative to Claude Design🧠

Open Design is a free, local-first alternative to Anthropic's Claude Design — with 71 brand-grade design systems and 19 skills built in, running on any AI CLI you already use.

→ Generate web, desktop, mobile prototypes, slides and videos

→ 71 brand-grade design systems ready to use out of the box

→ Sandboxed preview with HTML, PDF, PPTX and MP4 export

→ Works with Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Gemini, Copilot and more

→ Fully local, fully open source, your designs never leave your machine

If you've ever wished your AI coding agent could produce genuinely polished, production-ready designs without sending everything to the cloud, this is exactly that :))

Source 🔗 //github.com/nexu-io/open-design

tiktok.body:
Anthropic's Claude Design generates production-ready UI on a canvas but it's closed-source, cloud-only, and paywalled. Open-design is the local-first open-source alternative. Plugs into Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, Gemini CLI, OpenCode, and local Qwen. 19 design skills, 71 brand-grade design systems. Chat in your terminal, it renders into a sandboxed preview, then exports straight to HTML, PDF, or PowerPoint. #github #opensource
